scripts.install: npm run install-server && npm run install-client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,client "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.deploy: npm run build --prefix client && npm start --prefix server
scripts.deploy-cluster: npm run build --prefix client && npm run cluster --prefix server
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:server -- --coverage && npm run test:client -- --coverage
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:js -- --fix && npm run lint:css -- --fix
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
